title: James Gunn Likes a Fan's DC Timeline
summary: Keeping track of superhero movies can be hard. Now a fan has made it easier. A fan called comicbookcollide posted a list of DC movies and TV shows on Threads. The list puts the stories in order, like a timeline. James Gunn, one of the bosses at DC Studios, replied, "Timelines give me anxiety, but I think this is pretty good." That is high praise from the man in charge, though he did not call the list fully official. The timeline puts the new movie "Clayface" second, with its story set in 2021. It also includes "Blue Beetle," a 2023 movie. Gunn has said "Blue Beetle" counts as part of the new DC Universe. The timeline puts it in 2023, just before "Creature Commandos" Season 1, the first official DC Universe show. Gunn has been careful not to say the timeline is 100% right. He says "Blue Beetle" needs a few small changes, called retcons, to fit. The same is true of "Peacemaker" Season 1.
why_it_matters: If you love superhero movies, a timeline helps you watch them in the right story order.
